name: Content-Addressed Version Store
description: Repair a miniature content-addressed version-control store: deterministic object ids, content-based tree diffs, a true lowest-common-ancestor merge base over the commit DAG, sorted merge parents, ref bookkeeping that advances the current branch, and a three-way line merge that reports conflicts instead of silently resolving them.
planted_defect: objects.object_id ignores kind and unsorted JSON keys
tree.tree_diff compares path names not content
commit.merge_base returns any common ancestor not the LCA
refs.advance_head always writes 'main' not current branch
merge3.merge_blobs silently keeps ours on conflict without reporting
